title: 只剩姓名的名册
summary: 部分英烈只有姓名、籍贯或部队线索，缺少照片和遗物。博物馆以“待考证铭牌”显示，不用想象替代证据。
summaryEn: Some martyrs survive in the record only through names, hometowns, or force clues, without photographs or relics. The museum displays them as research plaques rather than inventing evidence.

title: red-map 作为总路线展板
summary: 现有路线地图保留为博物馆核心展板，用于承接所有人物、事件和地点链接。
summaryEn: The existing route map remains the museum's central digital panel and carries links to people, events, and places.

title: 彝海结盟条目
summary: 彝海结盟展现长征中的民族工作、纪律和地方协助，不只是军事行军条目。
summaryEn: The Yihai alliance shows ethnic-relations work, discipline, and local support during the Long March, not merely a marching node.

title: 随军婴儿的生命线
titleEn: The Infant Carried with the Column
summary: 贺捷生的展板把战争路线转化为家庭与生命的叙事，使观众看到宏大路线中的具体人。
summaryEn: He Jiesheng's panel turns the military route into a story of family and life, helping visitors see individual lives within the larger route.

title: 资料进入展馆的流程
summary: 外部材料先进入研究目录，经过摘录、去重、事实拆分、来源标注和候选条目审校后，再进入正式 CSV。
summaryEn: External material first enters the research folder, then moves through excerpting, deduplication, fact splitting, source tagging, and candidate review before entering official CSV files.
